name: AK8 - Indoor CO2 Monitor & Detector (CO2, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared Sensor, Arc Display
highlights: One Number, Read From the Doorway — A single CO₂ value sits inside a green-to-amber-to-red arc that fills the screen. Nothing competes for attention, so the band registers from across a meeting room before you read the digits.

Infrared, Not Semiconductor — NDIR responds to CO₂ and nothing else. Cooking vapour, hand sanitiser and air freshener leave the reading untouched — which is what makes a ventilation decision defensible.
Comfort Context Underneath — Temperature and humidity in two supporting circles, because a CO₂ figure alone does not explain why a room feels stuffy.
1200 mAh, 6–8 Hours — USB-C charging in about three hours; runs a full school day or shift without a socket.
For Buyers Who Want CO₂ Only — The cleanest single-parameter proposition in the range, at a lower landed cost than any multi-gas unit. 50 pcs per carton.
